title: A change is saved whole or not at all, through a crash at any point of its write
when: On a copy of the Tool Library's data, runs each aggregate's commands as one write stopped as a crash would stop it, then opens the store again.
then: Expects the data as it was before the write, or as the write meant, never a mix of the two.

title: A refused Check command gives every reason and changes no file
when: Adds a check named like one of Lathe's, and changes and removes one of Lathe's own.
then: Expects each refused with its reason, naming lathe/data/check.jsonl, and no file changed.

title: A command its aggregate refuses prints every reason with its rule, exits 1 and changes nothing
when: Runs commands their aggregates refuse from the CLI: an aggregate under a domain that does not exist, one whose ID is outside its domain, and a link to a record of the wrong kind.
then: Expects every reason printed with its rule, an exit code of 1 and the data files unchanged.

title: A write is checked whole, all or nothing and one at a time, rewriting only its own tables' files and naming every problem
when: Applies writes the store refuses (a key in use, a bad parent, a row straight into a link table, a second root, a command after which the next is refused) and writes it accepts (an add, three adds at once).
then: Expects each refusal to name every problem with its rule and command and to leave the data and every file as they were, and each accepted write to rewrite only its own table's file, sorted by key, each on the state the one before it left.

title: The same runner holds the commands of Traceability and Checking: whole, all or nothing, one at a time
when: Runs Traceability's and Checking's own commands on a store: refused and accepted fills, followings and limits, a provider of the wrong kind, and two writes at once.
then: Expects each refused write to name every problem with its rule and leave every file as it was, the wrong provider refused before any file changes, each accepted write to rewrite only its own file, sorted by key, and both of two writes at once kept.

title: A refused Pattern following command gives every reason and changes no file
when: Follows a pattern twice, gives a setting the pattern lacks, and a value with a reason too.
then: Expects each refused with its reason, and no file changed.

title: A product config is read whole, and an unknown or foreign one is refused
when: Reads configs with an unknown setting, another schema version, another data folder and none at all.
then: Expects each refused with what is wrong, or read with the data folder it names.

title: A record's parts are read back as rows of their own table, in position order
when: Loads entity fields written out of position order, one with an example and some with a column name.
then: Expects the fields back by position under their entity, each with its column name when it has one.

title: A row whose parent is missing is refused on load with its file and line, and parts are read back in order
when: Loads a fill without its slot, and a following's setting values and a product's settings written out of order.
then: Expects the load refused naming the file and line, and the parts read back as rows of their own table in order.

title: A row without a required column, or with a value its column does not allow, is refused on load
when: For each kind, loads its first row without each required column other than its ID and parent columns, then with each enum column set to `bogus`.
then: Expects a `required` refusal on line 1 saying `<kind>.<column> is required`, and a `column` refusal on line 1 for the value.

title: Each reload is announced at once, and one checks run after a burst of changes
when: Changes a product's data files several times in a row while a view listens to the server.
then: Expects each reload announced at once, one checks' run after the burst, announced when ready.

title: Only this machine writes; another device is refused and marked read-only
when: Sends a write from this machine and from another address on the network.
then: Expects the write from this machine to pass, and the other refused and marked read-only.

title: Each command and query is named by one CLI command, one MCP tool and one route, none shared
when: Reads every command and query definition, whose identities are generated from Lathe's records, and Lathe's command records.
then: Expects each definition named by one CLI command, one MCP tool and one route, none shared.

title: Each query is named on its own on every interface
when: Reads every command and query definition.
then: Expects each query to have an ID, a CLI command, an MCP tool and a route no other definition has.

title: Asking any query changes no row and no data file
when: Loads a product with a record of every kind and asks each query that needs no record named, and each asked by an ID.
then: Expects every stored row and every data file to be as they were before.

title: Each Check command runs by name from the CLI, its tool and its route, and a refusal reaches each with its reason
when: Runs `lathe check <command>`, the check_ tools and POST /api/check/<command>, then commands the Check aggregate refuses through the CLI and the tool.
then: Expects each to run its one command with its fields, and each refusal printed or returned with its reason and no file changed.

title: A refused command prints every reason and exits 1 on the CLI, and its tool returns the same refusal as data
when: Runs commands their aggregates refuse from the CLI, then calls their MCP tools.
then: Expects every reason printed with its rule and exit code 1, the same refusal returned as data by the tool, and no file changed.

title: Each change runs as its one CLI command or exported function in a set-up product repo, and a refusal reaches either with its reasons
when: In a product repo set up by `lathe init`, runs changes through the CLI and through an Agent's script on the package's exports, then changes their aggregates refuse.
then: Expects each change written by its own command or function, a refusal printed with an error exit or seen as data-refused errors with its reasons, and no file changed.

title: An Agent writes each record through its own tool
when: On a temporary product, an Agent writes domains, use cases, flows, aggregates, tests, standards and technical records through their tools.
then: Expects each written by its own tool, with its fields, and read back as given.

title: Each Pattern following command runs by name from the CLI, its tool and its route, and a refusal reaches each with its reason
when: Runs `lathe pattern-following <command>`, the pattern_following_ tools and POST /api/pattern-following/<command>, then follows a pattern twice through each.
then: Expects each to run its one command with its fields, and each refusal printed or returned with its reason and no file changed.

title: The page in the desktop app has only its bridge, and no access to the machine
when: Starts the built desktop app on a product folder and reads what its page can reach.
then: Expects only the bridge's members, and no access to the machine from the page.

title: No package keeps an unused file, export or dependency
when: Runs the unused-code check over each package.
then: Expects no unused file, export or dependency in any of them.
